name: Axis-Aligned Projection via Face Normal
definition: A geometry shader technique that projects 3D mesh triangles onto a 2D plane aligned with the axis most perpendicular to the triangle's face normal. This ensures that for any triangle, the projection minimizes overlap and distortion by choosing the optimal viewing axis (X, Y, or Z) based on the face normal.
summary: Axis-Aligned Projection via Face Normal is a geometry shader technique that projects 3D triangles onto the 2D plane aligned with the axis most perpendicular to the face normal to minimize distortion and overlap.
